_help: Feeds the weekly 'opportunity finder' and 'art-job watcher' routines. Edit it in the admin's Calendar tab. calendarId is the dedicated public Google Calendar the routines write to (Settings → Integrate calendar → Calendar ID). Everything under profile/jobs is plain English the routine reads to judge fit. notInterested: paste an event title or link here and it will never be suggested again.

profile.summary: Kayla Carabes is an oil painter based in Seattle, WA. Born in Houston, TX. BFA in Painting from RISD. Her work ranges from small panels to 6-foot canvases; figurative and narrative, with a strong sense of colour and humour.
profile.lookingFor: Juried group exhibitions, open calls, artist residencies (especially funded), grants and fellowships for painters, public-art and mural commissions, art fairs with reasonable booth fees, gallery calls for representation.
profile.geography: Seattle and the Puget Sound area first; Washington state and the Pacific Northwest; national (US) calls that accept shipped or digital submissions; online/virtual exhibitions. Texas-based calls are fine (Houston roots).
profile.avoid: Vanity galleries and pay-to-play 'international art prize' sites with vague juries. Anything asking for exclusive rights or the artist to buy back work. Student-only or under-25 calls. Digital/NFT-only platforms. Calls whose deadline has already passed.

jobs.summary: Teaching artist, art instructor, museum or gallery roles, studio assistant, muralist, illustration or design-adjacent creative roles. Part-time and freelance are fine.
jobs.location: Seattle metro (in person) or fully remote. Skip roles that require relocating.
jobs.avoid: Unpaid positions, commission-only sales roles, anything that is really a franchise or MLM.
